messages:
jen: FYI opened SDK PR that changes auth header shape, dependent on API change. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/sdk/pull/412
jen: tagging @arjun since API needs to accept the new header plus a backwards-compatibility flag
jen: aim is to land SDK today if we can sequence the API + console updates, otherwise we'll feature-flag it
arjun: saw the PR, thanks. quick question: is this additive or will it break current clients?
jen: additive on SDK side but it expects API to echo X-Rw-Client-Version in responses; if absent, SDK falls back. so small compat hit if API doesn't implement echo.
arjun: okay. I can add the echo in API, but it requires a tiny schema bump to responses and a minor migration in runtime that reads header -> response metadata.
arjun: propose this order: 1) API patch (no behavior change for old clients, adds echo header) 2) runtime deployment (helm values tweak) 3) SDK merge + release 4) console update to consume new field
maria: console here — we'll need to adapt the schema mapping in ui/api-client.ts and a small rendering change in settings page. estimate ~2-3 dev hours after API is live.
maria: also want a heads-up about the new field name so we can stop doing the ad-hoc parsing in console code.
sam: heads-up on release windows — we're in a partial merge freeze until 14:00 UTC for the infra rollout. if we need to thread this through, we should schedule for the 16:00 window or get an exception.
tess: QA: can we feature-flag the console change behind a config so we can toggle if something odd happens?
jen: yes, SDK will ship behind feature flag by default off. we can flip after console updates are deployed.
arjun: I'll open the API PR now: https://git.redwood/infra/api/pull/981
arjun: small note: runtime needs a helm values key rwClientVersion.enabled = true. @sam — is that fine to add to runtime/staging for the next deploy?
sam: fine, add to values-staging.yaml and ping me for prod promotion. I'll queue it for the 16:00 slot.
ci-bot: sdk/pull/412 — build: passed, unit tests: ok, integration: flaky (2/3)
jen: re: flaky tests, pushed a repro fix in the test harness, trigger CI again with `/retest`
releasebot: deployment window reserved for 16:00 UTC — ticket #INF-1298
arjun: API PR updated, added echo and backward-compat tests. PTAL @jen @maria
maria: looking now, will run local smoke against console mock.
jen: once API merged and runtime helm change applied to staging, I'll cut SDK beta and post the release notes in #devex.
maria: will prepare console branch that reads rwClientVersion from response.meta and gate behind RW_SHOW_NEW_HEADER flag.
sam: when you push helm change, include this snippet in values-staging.yaml: ```rwClientVersion:
  enabled: true
  default: false```
jen: noted. thanks all. tagging this thread for follow-up: I'll post final merge checklist after the API merge. :thumbsup:
